top_stories.title: Certighost Exploit Lets Low-Privileged Active Directory Users Impersonate a Domain Controller
top_stories.summary: Researchers have published a working exploit called "Certighost" that allows low-privileged Active Directory users to obtain a Domain Controller certificate and authenticate as that machine via Kerberos. The exploit enables DCSync attacks to retrieve the krbtgt secret by abusing Domain Controller directory replication rights, representing a critical Active Directory privilege escalation and authentication bypass vulnerability.

top_stories.title: Default Azure Automation Setting Enables Cross-Tenant Identity Takeover
top_stories.summary: Microsoft fixed a vulnerability in Azure Automation where a public-by-default configuration combined with code flaws could allow attackers to take over another tenant's identity. The attack chain could expose data, credentials, and cloud workloads across tenant boundaries.

top_stories.title: Flaws in Passkey Implementation Show Old Attacks Still Work
top_stories.summary: Researchers discovered exploitable flaws in Microsoft's passkey implementation that could allow attackers to impersonate privileged users. The findings, revealed ahead of Black Hat USA, demonstrate that legacy attack techniques remain effective against modern passwordless authentication mechanisms.

top_stories.title: Okta、実行時におけるAIエージェントの保護と継続的なガバナンス自動化を実現する新機能を発表
top_stories.summary: Okta announced new features for securing AI agents at runtime, including Agent Gateway, Agent-to-Agent Connections, and Resource Access Certifications for AI Agents. These capabilities aim to provide identity governance and access management for AI agents connecting to enterprise tools and executing multi-agent workflows.

top_stories.title: Goodbye SMS or phone calls — Microsoft is making passkeys the default authentication process for businesses
top_stories.summary: Microsoft is making passkeys the default authentication method for business accounts, moving away from SMS and phone call-based authentication. The company is urging enterprises to adopt passkeys as it positions them as the new standard, citing security limitations of SMS and voice-based MFA.

news.title: What the identity attack surface looks like when trust becomes the target
news.summary: F5's VP of Strategic Engineering Joel Moses discusses identity-based attack techniques including MFA fatigue, session token theft, and malicious application consent in a Help Net Security video. The presentation references the 2022 Uber breach and recommends defenses such as number matching, FIDO2 keys, and periodic third-party application access reviews.

news.title: Product showcase: LastPass Authenticator brings Face ID, Apple Watch, and cloud backup to 2FA
news.summary: LastPass has released a product showcase for its LastPass Authenticator app, highlighting features including Face ID support, Apple Watch compatibility, and cloud backup for two-factor authentication. The app supports TOTP-based verification codes, push notifications for one-tap approvals, and is available across iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, and Android devices.

news.title: CTM360 Research Reveals How Insurance Phishing Has Evolved Into Real-Time Account Hijacking
news.summary: CTM360 research reveals that phishing campaigns targeting insurance and financial institutions have evolved from credential harvesting to real-time account hijacking techniques. The attacks bypass traditional authentication defenses by intercepting sessions immediately rather than storing credentials for later use.

news.title: Hackers hijack hotel Wi-Fi DNS to steal Microsoft 365 accounts
news.summary: Hackers are hijacking DNS settings on Wi-Fi devices at hotels and conference centers to redirect users to fake Microsoft 365 login pages for credential theft. The attack targets Microsoft 365 authentication flows by manipulating network infrastructure to serve phishing login portals.

news.title: Chick-fil-A data breach affects more than 13,000 customers
news.summary: Chick-fil-A confirmed a credential stuffing attack between June 17-19 compromised over 13,000 customer accounts on its website and mobile app. The incident involved attackers using previously stolen credentials to gain unauthorized access to customer accounts.

news.title: Meta tackles AI-generated accounts with a free Facebook verification badge
news.summary: Meta has introduced Facebook Verified, a free badge for users who complete identity verification via a selfie check on Facebook. The feature is designed to distinguish human users from bots and AI-generated accounts in contexts such as Marketplace listings, dating profiles, and Group conversations.

news.title: Seeing AI Agents Is Not Enough. Security Teams Must Enforce What They Can Do
news.summary: The article discusses security enforcement for AI agents, focusing on least privilege access controls and identity-layer approaches to managing what AI agents are permitted to do. The piece covers multiple approaches including prompt filtering and identity-layer access controls as methods for governing AI agent authorization.

news.title: Russian Espionage Group Exploited Zimbra Zero-Day to Steal Mail and 2FA Codes
news.summary: A Russian state-sponsored espionage group exploited a zero-day vulnerability in Zimbra's webmail client to steal emails, browser-saved passwords, and two-factor authentication recovery codes from Western organizations. The NSA and CISA published an advisory on the campaign, which required only opening a message to trigger the payload and targeted the last 90 days of email along with full email directories.

news.title: World Foundation raises $52 million in token sale as proof-of-human demand accelerates
news.summary: World Foundation raised $52 million to expand World ID, an iris-scan-based digital identity verification system. The funding round was led by Pantera Capital with participation from Bain Capital Crypto and other investors.

news.title: CISO's guide to privileged identity management
news.summary: A guide aimed at CISOs addresses privileged identity management in the context of AI-era security challenges. The article focuses on moving beyond standing access privileges to better control user and non-human entity access to systems and data.

news.title: World Foundation Raises $52.5M to Scale Sam Altman’s ‘Proof of Human’ ID
news.summary: World Foundation raised $52.5M in a token sale led by Pantera Capital to scale its biometric "proof of human" identity network, originally developed by Sam Altman. The funding will support expansion of World's digital ID system, which uses iris scanning to verify human identity, with a focus on distinguishing humans from AI agents.

news.title: Hotel Wi-Fi Routers Compromised to Steal Corporate Login Credentials From Visitors
news.summary: ReliaQuest researchers identified a cyber espionage campaign using DNS poisoning attacks on hotel Wi-Fi routers to steal corporate login credentials from guests. The attacks specifically target the hospitality sector to intercept credentials from visiting business travelers.

news.title: Modernizing SAP identity management with Microsoft Entra
news.summary: Microsoft Entra has been positioned as a centralized identity control plane for SAP environments, integrating directly with SAP Cloud Identity Services and SAP Identity Access Governance. The integration enables organizations to automate identity lifecycle management across SAP applications through this combined architecture.

news.title: MCP Security Best Practices: Authentication, Authorization, and Secure Tooling
news.summary: The article covers security best practices for Model Context Protocol (MCP) implementations in .NET, focusing on authentication and authorization patterns for AI integrations. The content addresses how IAM concepts like authentication and authorization apply to securing AI tool integrations and enterprise data access in MCP environments.

news.title: How Synthetic Identity Fraud is Coming for Machine Identities
news.summary: The article examines synthetic identity fraud as it applies to machine identities, describing how attackers construct fabricated identities by combining real and fictitious data points to create non-existent entities. Unlike traditional identity theft, synthetic machine identity fraud goes undetected longer because no legitimate owner monitors for misuse.

news.title: Google Adds Selfie Video Recovery for Users Locked Out of Their Accounts
news.summary: Google has introduced a selfie video option as a new account recovery method for users locked out of their accounts. The feature supplements existing recovery methods such as email address or phone number verification, using video selfie biometrics to verify identity and restore account access.

news.title: VU#492466: Logto Identity Platform has authentication and authorization failures in core protocol handling
news.summary: The Logto Identity Platform has been found to contain multiple vulnerabilities affecting its identity-processing pipeline, assigned VU#492466. The flaws can allow attackers to bypass account-ownership checks and skip MFA enforcement, undermining authentication and authorization decisions.

news.title: FedRAMP Rev5 Is Ending: What the 20x Transition Really Requires
news.summary: FedRAMP is transitioning from Rev5 to FedRAMP 20x, replacing periodic point-in-time assessments with continuous, machine-readable evidence of security controls. The article outlines what this shift requires from organizations seeking or maintaining FedRAMP authorization.

news.title: Microsoft Copilot Deployments Delayed Over Security Concerns
news.summary: CoreView research found that security leaders are delaying Microsoft Copilot deployments due to concerns about AI assistants exposing confidential data. The concerns center on data access and permissions risks associated with AI tools operating within enterprise environments.

news.title: Lessons Learned from CISA’s Recent GitHub Leak
news.summary: CISA released a postmortem report on a data breach in which a contractor accidentally exposed dozens of internal credentials, including AWS GovCloud keys, in a public GitHub repository for nearly six months. The incident highlights failures in secrets management and credential exposure detection, with the agency's delayed response providing lessons for security teams on handling leaked credentials.

news.title: Scattered Spider Hackers Plead Guilty on Day 1 of Trial
news.summary: Two members of the Scattered Spider cybercrime group pleaded guilty in the UK to charges related to an August 2024 cyberattack on Transport for London. Scattered Spider is known for sophisticated social engineering and identity-based attacks, including SIM swapping and MFA bypass techniques used to compromise organizational access controls.

news.title: Hackers Used Meta’s AI Support Bot to Seize Instagram Accounts
news.summary: Hackers exploited Meta's AI support assistant chatbot to reset Instagram account passwords and seize accounts, including high-profile ones belonging to the Obama White House and U.S. Space Force Chief Master Sergeant. Instructions for manipulating the AI bot to bypass normal account authentication and recovery processes were shared on Telegram, enabling the account takeovers.
